title: Principal
description: Authenticated identity as established by the admission context. Principals appear only inside provider state (grants, receipts, audit fields) and as target selectors in admin ops; the requester's principal never comes from a payload (MEM-R003). §6.4 defines no schema_version for this reference object.

principal_id.description: Opaque authenticated identity. A payload principal_id names a target grantee; it never reassigns the requester.
